integrity: Characteristic-three algebra and conductor are proved explicitly; finite-field checks are supplementary. Historical priority, especially in older scroll literature, remains a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: The computation concerns the coefficientwise reduction of one specified projective integral model, not all models of the characteristic-zero Schur quartic; no relative Fano-scheme multiplicities or stable-reduction claims are made. General Frobenius scroll theory may imply aspects of the result under a different name.
title: Frobenius-scroll normalization of the characteristic-three Schur quartic model
